fact: ISO's member record states the Somali Bureau of Standards is a national standards body established by an Act of parliament (the Somali Standards and Quality Control law, Lr27) and operational since early 2020; the record gives no date, so the published date 2026-08-29 is used for the state of affairs.

The US International Trade Administration says the Somali Bureau of Standards is the national standards body, responsible for developing and implementing standards, and has adopted 145 standards in various fields over three years.
HoA DRIVE Somalia describes the Somali Bureau of Standards as overseeing quality and compliance services for goods in Somalia, with a searchable catalogue of national standards on its new platform.
